title: LuminaGrid
tagline: A DePIN of autonomous AI agents balancing power grids and settling energy trades onchain.
description: LuminaGrid is an agent-centric middleware protocol that enables Autonomous Agents to discover, negotiate, and settle transactions for real-world resources (energy and compute). By leveraging the Ethereum ecosystem, LuminaGrid transforms "passive" grids into "active" markets where agents represent hardware nodes and consumers.
how_its_made:
The project is incomplete! But below is the (provisional) vision.

LuminaGrid is engineered as a multi-layered agentic protocol that bridges physical energy assets with the Ethereum ecosystem. At its core, the system utilizes a hub-and-spoke agent architecture. We'll build the primary agent logic using Python and the LangChain framework, enabling nodes to perform autonomous discovery and negotiation. These agents operate as ERC-4337 Smart Accounts via Safe, allowing them to hold funds, sign transactions, and execute logic without manual user intervention.
